title: Shop freezers in seven European countries hit by cyber-attack
description: The temperature of freezers in several shops across Europe reportedly rose to as high as 50C.

title: 'All this food is now useless': Piles of rubbish after shop freezers hit by cyber-attack
description: Dozens of supermarkets in seven European countries dumped huge quantities of food after refrigerators and freezers were targeted in a cyber-attack.

title: Channel 4 documentary and journalists 'poisoned the well' against Russell Brand, court hears
description: Brand's defence barrister told jurors that Brand "had an immense amount of sex", but that "none of it was unlawful".

title: Russian bombing kills 24 people at Ukraine aid centre, Kyiv says
description: Local officials say 27 people had been missing after at least nine 3,000kg aerial bombs hit a village in southern Ukraine.

title: Mother told to book appointment to give birth to her baby who had died
description: Newcastle Hospitals NHS Trust apologises for care it says "fell short of the standards" expected.

title: MP Carla Lockhart quits DUP in Drumcree row
description: Lockhart had called for the DUP to remove First Minister Michelle O'Neill from office.

title: Fighting returns to Kherson region after longest Ukraine war ceasefire
description: Though unprecedented, the six-day truce has done little to alter the wider trajectory of a war that continues to grinds on.

title: Man who drugged and raped wife with strangers 'led double life'
description: Nine men are on trial accused of helping a Stockport man fulfil "barbaric fantasies" against his wife.

title: Prosecutors hint at retrial for Lindsay Clancy on murder charges
description: Judge William Sullivan said if the case is headed to a retrial, that could happen as soon as March 2027.
